description.value: The Vista Inn is a locally owned, recently renovated motel in Kamloops offering unobstructed views of the river confluence and Mount Peter and Mount Paul. The building has been fully updated with new furnishings and no carpet, and rooms feature Nespresso machines, air conditioning, and balconies. It bills itself as centrally located with free parking, dog-friendly rooms, and a sustainability focus including recyclable coffee pods.

address.value: 626 Columbia St W, V2C 1L1, Kamloops BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence. The King Bed room page (/room/king-bed/) explicitly lists 'Bike Storage' as a room amenity alongside Air Conditioning, WiFi, etc., confirming bike storage is offered. The front page confirms coin-operated guest laundry and a grab-and-go breakfast included with standard rate packages. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is corroborated by 'WiFi' listed in room amenities. Contact details (phone, address) are confirmed via the /contact-us/ page.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-214-6800 sourced from website /contact-us/ page only.
Bike storage is listed as an amenity but no description of the security arrangement (locked, staff-controlled, etc.) is provided on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating motel in Kamloops with a functional website, booking system, and confirmed bike storage — a clear include for the WWC directory.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Bring your bike right into your room and keep it safe overnight, then get it dialed in at our on-site bike wash station after a dusty day out.

Laundry.detail: Website front page: 'coin operated guest laundry facilities' available for longer stays or travellers passing through

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Website front page: 'Grab-and-go breakfast — Grab a quick and easy breakfast before you start your day—included with standard rate packages.'
